drafts.body:
Hi Ben,

It's been a while since we spoke. You'd asked me to reach back out mid-September, and we did, but I know things get busy.

Just wanted to check in — is the postcode throttling and lead qualification still something you want to solve for SogoSolar? Our system has improved quite a bit since then, so if it's still on the table I can show you what it looks like now.

Let me know either way.
drafts.reason_hr: Dug period od 30 dana otkad smo poslali zadnji mail. Ben je tražio mid-September; sada je kraj listopada. Kratki nastavak, bez izmišljanja, stvarni prototip je spomenut ali ne obećavamo novi.

drafts.reason_hr: 316 dana, reagirao je na prvi email i rekao da će pogledati video u siječnju. User traži priznanje dugačke tišine, točan stari zahtjev (pogledati video), a naš sustav je napredovao. Loom link je provjereni lead-gen VSL. Daje mu jedan jasan CTA za kratki poziv.
